text:
The positive culture on hektoen enteric agar, per the team note, points to a flagellated intestinal parasite rather than a bacterial pathogen, so the most likely agent is *Giardia lamblia* (giardiasis), which can also follow antibiotic use. *C. difficile* remains a consideration for post-antibiotic diarrhea, but it would not be identified via this medium.  
CONFIDENCE: 55
